reviewed_by: Codex review of provider health retry coverage
reason: Provider inference already uses the shared bounded retry mechanism, but OpenAI-compatible and OpenRouter health discovery bypassed it. The selected tests prove that refused connections are retried and can recover on both paths, that exhausted OpenRouter attempts return an actionable unhealthy result, and that an exhausted httpx ConnectError is classified as a retryable dependency outage instead of an unknown internal fault.
exclusions: No frontend tests or Playwright journeys: the ProviderHealth response shape and existing Settings Check interaction are unchanged. No native tests: no Rust code changed. No live OpenRouter request: the retry contract is deterministic at the provider adapter boundary and must not depend on external service availability. Other provider tests and full suites are unrelated and explicitly excluded.
